nano home/benjaminpi2/start_epaper_display.sh
sudo chmod +x home/benjaminpi2/start_epaper_display.sh

nano /etc/systemd/system/epaper_display_startup.service

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable epaper_display_startup.service
sudo systemctl restart epaper_display_startup.service
sudo systemctl status epaper_display_startup.service
